entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy., Deptt. Of Home, Lucknow
Counsel for Applicant :- Firoz Ahmad Khan,Mohd. Vakar Khan
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

In terms of the F.I.R., allegations were levelled for commission of offence under Section 376 I.P.C.
by the father of the victim.
Subsequently, in her statements under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone out of her own free will.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that in the statements made under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that she had gone with the applicant out of her own free will.
Tentatively, the age of the victim is shown to 18 years.
The applicant is in custody since 14.3.2024 and has no criminal history, hence the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Chandan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned A.G.A. also opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. which do not support the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is in custody since 14.3.2024, and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
6.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Chandan be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No.120 of 2024, under Sections 323, 328, 376, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Aodhya/ Faizabad on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions :-
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Shukla  Chandan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy., Deptt. ... on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/123933098/
